description: Fraeylemaborg is a U-shaped manor across a moat, with a Louis XVI centre on the main front and an off-centre tower that turns from square to octagon under a wooden spire. Two bells hang on iron arms outside that tower. The museum is closed. Two older front towers were removed after 1781 and are not restored. The sky is overcast, about 9.1°C, with wind near 7.6 km/h and cloud cover about 84%. No cafe name is shown.
